request_summary: Take a read-only before snapshot of the newly created issuer table, then rerun the GEC suite on DEV.

actions.description: Read the configured issuer table in the three fixture partitions before launching; the request was refused with an authorization permission mismatch, so the runner stopped without starting behave and reported blocked.
The orchestrator reverted the temporary endpoint override.

outcome.detail: The runner stopped correctly at the failed read-only precondition; the data-plane permission of the signed-in identity is still missing or not yet effective, so no test ran and no remote state changed.

friction.description: A third consecutive run attempt was blocked at the table read; the identity that DefaultAzureCredential selects may differ from the one that received the role, and this cannot be checked without probes outside the approved plan.
